text: L'Ecole Viamonde will soon be opening a new school at the intersection of Mountjoy Avenue and Ladysmith Avenue. I have heard from residents of Mountjoy who are concerned about the impacts of traffic to and from the school on permit parking in their neighbourhood and they have requested an extension of the permit parking hours on Mountjoy Avenue. This letter includes recommendations to extend permit parking hours to ensure access to parking for local residents.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Mountjoy Avenue, between Greenwood Avenue and 37 Mountjoy Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
